title: Delegated ops playbook for RBAC v2: audit triage & SSO incident macros
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: produce a support-grade operator playbook and macros for RBAC v2 incidents (misassigned roles, delegated admin mistakes), audit-log triage, and SSO/SAML login failures. This ticket bundles: (1) a concise runbook ops can follow during a support shift, (2) templated support macros for Slack/Ticketing, (3) example audit queries and remediation commands, and (4) a short enablement checklist for Customer Success engineers.

Scope (what this doc is expected to include):
- Step-by-step triage for RBAC anomalies (role drift, missing permissions after migration to RBAC v2).
- Audit log query patterns for the audit-store (Kibana/Elasticsearch and internal audit API).
- SSO/SAML failure troubleshooting flow (IdP errors vs. Redwood side errors).
- Safe remediation steps and rollback guidance (role assignment patch examples, least-privilege reverts).
- Support macros for common situations (user locked out, delegated-admin mistake, bulk role rollback).
- Follow-ups and required telemetry/metrics to collect for post-incident RCA.

Decisions and trade-offs recorded so far:
- We will keep the playbook intentionally short (one page canonical runbook) and link to deeper engineering runbooks for kernel-level fixes. Rationale: support engineers need actionable steps under time pressure; long runbooks cause cognitive overload.
- Audit retention guidance: recommend 90 days by default for hosted customers, with note about cost. Trade-off: 90 days balances investigation window vs. storage cost; enterprise customers may opt for 365 days via contract.
- Macros will be plain-text templates (Slack/Ticket) with parameter placeholders for names/IDs rather than a dynamic macro system. Rationale: faster to ship and easy to maintain; future iteration can integrate with Zendesk/HubSpot APIs.

Runbook (one-page canonical flow):
1) Receive alert or ticket. Record ticket ID and affected customer org_id.
2) Verify SSO health: check SSO provider status (okta.com/okta-status or IdP status page) and verify metadata fingerprint. If IdP is down, bubble up to customer success and set expected ETA.
3) Query audit log for relevant events (examples below). Look for correlated events +/- 5 minutes of failure.
4) If RBAC role change is implicated, validate change author and reason. If change originated from an automated migration job, pause migrations and escalate to engineering.
5) Apply safe temporary fix: create a scoped admin role ("temp-delegated-admin-<ticket>") with minimal permissions to unblock user, log the change, and schedule a rollback.
6) Collect artifacts (audit snapshots, affected resources, session ids) and escalate for RCA if customer impact > medium.

Audit query examples (replace variables in double braces):
- Kibana (Elasticsearch): event.type: "rbac_change" AND event.action: "role.assign" AND actor.email: "{{actor_email}}" AND target.user_email: "{{user_email}}"
- Time-bounded search: timestamp:["{{start_iso}}" TO "{{end_iso}}"] AND (event.action: "role.assign" OR event.action: "role.remove")
- SSO login failures: event.type: "sso" AND outcome: "failure" AND meta.idp_error_code: "{{idp_code}}"
- Internal audit API (curl): curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_KEY" "https://audit.internal.redwood/v1/events?org={{org_id}}&q=event.action:role.assign&from={{start}}&to={{end}}"

Safe remediation examples (always confirm with the customer for destructive ops):
- Re-assign role via API (example): curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://console.redwood/api/v1/orgs/{{org_id}}/users/{{user_id}}/roles" -d '{"roles":["workspace.viewer"]}'
- Create temporary delegated admin (audit note required): CLI: rwdctl iam role create --org {{org_id}} --name "temp-delegated-admin-{{ticket}}" --permissions "users.read,users.update" --ttl 24h

Support macros (copy/paste into ticket or Slack; replace values):
- User locked out after SSO change:
  Subject: [RBAC V2] User {{user_email}} cannot sign in after IdP update
  Body: Hi team, user {{user_email}} on org {{org_id}} reports SSO failures after recent IdP metadata update. Checked IdP status: {{idp_status}}. Recent audit events: {{audit_snippet}}. Temporary action taken: created temp role temp-delegated-admin-{{ticket}}. Requesting follow-up from identity infra to validate metadata and re-create SAML assertion mapping.
- Delegated admin accidentally removed rights:
  Subject: [RBAC] Delegated admin role removal for {{actor_email}}
  Body: We detected role change by {{actor_email}} at {{timestamp}} removing {{role}} from {{target_user}}. Action taken: reverted to previous roles and created an audit entry. Please review permission policy to ensure least privilege.
- Bulk rollback (operator macro):
  Subject: [RBAC V2] Rolling back role migration batch {{batch_id}}
  Body: Triggered rollback for batch {{batch_id}} to restore pre-migration roles. Rollback command: rwdctl iam migration rollback --batch {{batch_id}} --dry-run=false. Notify impacted users: {{communication_template_link}}.

Enablement checklist (for CS & L2 support):
- Read canonical one-page runbook and bookmark audit query templates.
- Run through 2 short lab scenarios (RBAC drift + SSO auth failure). Labs are located in Confluence link below.
- Confirm access to audit read keys and Kibana.
- Practice using the temporary delegated-admin pattern and verify audit entries are emitted.

Telemetry & dashboards to consult:
- Authentication failures by IdP (rate & spikes) - Console > Auth > IdP Metrics
- RBAC change volume and authors - Console > Audit > RBAC Events

Notes on follow-ups:
- Engineering action item: add a short audit field that records migration_job_id on automated migrations (ENG-9251 dependency).
- Product action item: document delegated admin UX edge-cases in the RBAC docs and add a warning when creating time-limited admin roles.

Links to artifacts and evidence: see the links field below for Confluence playbook, demo lab, and the GH PR that wires up the temp-role CLI command.
acceptance_criteria: One-page canonical runbook checked into Confluence with clear owner and version
Three support macros added to Support KB and a sample Slack snippet published
Audit query templates validated against staging audit store and included in runbook
L2/CS enablement lab published and at least one engineer has completed it
All remediation commands include explicit audit notes and rollback instructions
